name: Token Foundry
description: Idle foundry whose currency is your workspace tokens, with a balance rail, a side panel of upgrades, and a smith that bounces along the bottom.

tools.description: Return the Token Foundry wallet, income rate, and upgrades for this workspace without advancing time.
Apply offline idle income and sync the wallet to the workspace token ledger.

observed_tokens.description: Current cumulative workspace totalTokens. Omit to accrue idle income only.

tools.description: Buy levels of a Token Foundry upgrade with tokens on hand.

upgrade_id.description: Upgrade id from get_state, such as inkwell or press.

count.description: How many levels to buy: a positive integer (default 1) or "max" for as many as affordable.

tools.description: Claim a Token Foundry power-up, such as the one the foundry sprite drops when clicked.

powerup_id.description: Power-up id from get_state, such as overclock or surge.

tools.description: Retrain the foundry: reset balance, generators, and perks for permanent insight (+5% income each).
